parsed.rationale: I disagree with anterior MI: this is sinus rhythm with high precordial voltage and mild J-point elevation in V2–V4 with concordant upright T waves (a normal or early-repolarization pattern), and it has no pathological Q waves, no convex or tombstone ST elevation, no reciprocal ST depression and no T-wave inversion.
